sn3.16:1.4: From the verses below, it is clear this is because he hoped for a son.
sn3.16:3.2: Commentary glosses _posa_ with _posehi_, i.e. the ablative plural in comparative sense.
sn3.16:3.3: Bṛhadāraṇyaka Upaniṣad 6.4.17 gives a rite for those who wish to have a daughter who is astute and learned (_paṇḍitā_).
